name: Start a blob upload
description: Start a blob upload POST /v2/:teamSlug/:projectSlug/:repositoryName/blobs/uploads/[?mount= &from= ] Initiate a blob upload. POST /v2/{teamSlug}/{projectSlug}/{repositoryName}/blobs/uploads/
context:
POST /v2/{teamSlug}/{projectSlug}/{repositoryName}/blobs/uploads/
POST /v2/:teamSlug/:projectSlug/:repositoryName/blobs/uploads/[?mount= &from= ] Initiate a blob upload. Returns a UUID in the Location header that the client uses for subsequent PATCH (chunk) and PUT (complete) requests.
Required: teamSlug (path) — Single Docker repository team slug component.; projectSlug (path) — Single Docker repository project slug component.; repositoryName (path) — Single Docker repository name component.
Optional: mount (query) — Digest of the blob to mount from another repository.; from (query) — Source repository to mount the blob from.

name: Delete a blob
description: Delete a blob DELETE /v2/:teamSlug/:projectSlug/:repositoryName/blobs/:digest Blob deletion is intentionally not supported. DELETE /v2/{teamSlug}/{projectSlug}/{repositoryName}/blobs/{digest}

name: Cancel a blob upload
description: Cancel a blob upload DELETE /v2/:teamSlug/:projectSlug/:repositoryName/blobs/uploads/:uuid Cancel an in-flight blob upload. DELETE /v2/{teamSlug}/{projectSlug}/{repositoryName}/blobs/uploads/{uuid}

name: Download a blob
description: Download a blob GET /v2/:teamSlug/:projectSlug/:repositoryName/blobs/:digest Fetch a blob by digest. GET /v2/{teamSlug}/{projectSlug}/{repositoryName}/blobs/{digest}

name: Get blob upload status
description: Get blob upload status GET /v2/:teamSlug/:projectSlug/:repositoryName/blobs/uploads/:uuid Query the status of an in-progress blob upload. GET /v2/{teamSlug}/{projectSlug}/{repositoryName}/blobs/uploads/{uuid}

name: Complete a blob upload
description: Complete a blob upload PUT /v2/:teamSlug/:projectSlug/:repositoryName/blobs/uploads/:uuid?digest= Complete the blob upload. PUT /v2/{teamSlug}/{projectSlug}/{repositoryName}/blobs/uploads/{uuid}

name: Upload a blob chunk
description: Upload a blob chunk PATCH /v2/:teamSlug/:projectSlug/:repositoryName/blobs/uploads/:uuid Upload a chunk of blob data. PATCH /v2/{teamSlug}/{projectSlug}/{repositoryName}/blobs/uploads/{uuid}
